locations.title: Pure (Sciel)
locations.description:
Complete the Grandis Fashionist's questions as Sciel to receive this as a reward

  - Life's a river winding through the valleys of despair... -> It meets the sea's embrace, where sorrow turns to air.
  - Life's a story written with the ink of dreams and fears... -> And death the final chapter, where we shed our tears.
  - Life's a blazing comet, racing through the sky... -> Its light will softly fade, where weary skies lie.

locations.title: Pure (Lune)
locations.description:
Complete the Grandis Fashionist's questions as Lune to receive this as a reward
  - Life blooms like a rose, with petals soft and frail... -> Winter winds will whisper, the ending of the tale.
  - Life's a canvas painted with the colours of our strife... -> Death the artist's final stroke, completing every life.
  - Life sings a song of joy and pain, its notes both sweet and bitter... -> Its echoes fade to stillness, our secrets follow after.

locations.title: Pure (Maelle)
locations.description:
Complete the Grandis Fashionist's questions as Maelle to receive this as a reward

  - Life is but a fleeting dream, a whisper in the night... -> While shadows fade to silence, gone beyond our sight.
  - Through the veil of shadows, life's mysteries are spun... -> Death untangles threads, revealing what's begun.  
  - Life dances on the edge of time, a flicker in the breeze... -> Eternity then cradles us, a promise to appease.

locations.title: Intact Mine
locations.description:
**Location:** To find an Intact Mine, walk toward the cliff east of the [Demineur’s](#loc=457670) location to find a series of column-like rock formations you can leap across. Jump across the rock formations to reach the eastern clearing pictured above. While leaping, remember that Clair Obscur features a mantle mechanic, so you don’t need to land perfectly on each platform to advance. But if you fall at any point, you can return to the starting point by climbing up the [handholds attached to the western rockface](#loc=474618).

When you reach the eastern platform, turn to face southward, and you should be able to spot a purple-glowing item in the distance. Next, leap onto the elongated rock formation to your right, and walk to the southern end of the surface before jumping south again to land on a small ledge. Lastly, jump onto the cylinder-like rock formation to your left, and hop toward the purple-glowing item to collect an Intact Mine.

**Use:** Give to [Demineur (Nevron)](#loc=457670)

locations.title: Demineur (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with Demineur, found inside [Flying Waters](#loc=448438).  From [Noco's Hut rest point](#loc=474607), head north into the clearing with the giant anchor.  Continue clockwise around the anchor and then through the circular, vase-like structure in the upper corner   

**Quest Steps:**
- Examine Demineur, but do not attack them
- Traverse the platforming challenge and retrieve the [Intact Mine](#loc=458084)
- Return to Demineur and give them the Intact Mine

**Rewards:**
- [Deminerim (Lune)](#loc=448933) (level 3)
- Colour of Lumina x3 (Must kill Demineur) 
- Chroma Catalyst (Must kill Demineur)

locations.title: Karatom
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Find and speak with this tiny Gestral, west through the alley from the Chief House inside the [Gestral Village](#loc=448439)   

**Quest Steps:**
- Gain access to [Esquie's Nest](#loc=448435) by progressing the main story
- Retrieve the Blue [Mushroom](#loc=492396) in [Esquie's Nest](#loc=448435) and give it to Karatom
- Defeat Karatom's Ultimate Sakapatate in battle! 

**Rewards:**
- [Pure](#loc=524913) (Gustave outfit)
- Polished Chroma Catalyst x3
- Recoat

**Note:** This quest cannot be completed after Act I

locations.title: Bourgeon (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with the small Bourgeon inside [The Small Bourgeon](#loc=448574) location - found southeast beyond the Expedition 53 flag rest point   

**Quest Steps:**
- Locate and defeat any one of the fully-grown Bourgeon optional bosses found throughout The Continent:
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=449460) (this one is easiest)
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=448512)
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=448531)
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=448554)
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=448611)
  - [Bourgeon](#loc=521686)
- Bring the dropped [Bourgeon Skin](#loc=474955) back to the small Bourgeon 

**Rewards:**
- Colour of Lumina 
- Colour of Lumina x5 (Must kill the Grown Bourgeon)
- Polished Chroma Catalyst (Must kill the Grown Bourgeon)

locations.title: Alexsoundro
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with Alexsoundro, a tall and lanky Gestral standing near the lone column between the giant Sakapatate and the jousting area inside of the [Gestral Village](#loc=448439)  

**Quest Steps:**
- Agree to rescue Alexsoundro's [patate](#loc=475478) 
- Head north toward the Arena 
- Take an immediate right to march down the southeastern path, then take a slight left
- At the end of the eastern passage, use the [rope](#loc=475474) to climb onto an overhead platform
- Next, take a few steps west and use the [grapple point](#loc=475476) to clear the gap 
- From the other side, go north and [traverse the wall](#loc=475477) to your left towards the [patate](#loc=475478)
- Finally, mantle over the short wall, and with a running start, leap onto the column to reach and speak to the [patate](#loc=475478)

**Rewards:**
- [Sakapatate ](#loc=475479)(Lune outfit)

locations.title: Ono-Puncho
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Find and speak to the purple Gestral inside the [Gestral Village](#loc=448439)  

**Quest Steps:**
- Agree to the challenge of hitting Ono-Puncho with a single attack dealing 9,999 damage 

**Rewards:**
- [Sakapatate (Maelle outfit)](#loc=504428)

locations.title: Hexga (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Start at the Old Farm rest point flag found inside the [Stone Wave Cliffs](#loc=448434), then head south and take a slight right as you approach the wall to follow the lantern-lined path.  When you reach the top of the hill, take a left, then use the handholds on the right wall to climb toward the Hexga

**Quest Steps:**
- Enter the nearby cave, use the grapple point to cross the gap, then head east and descend the rope to the lower level
- Find all three glowing rock crystals in the large underground area:
  - [Glowing Rock Crystal I](#loc=458546)
  - [Glowing Rock Crystal II](#loc=458547)
  - [Glowing Rock Crystal III](#loc=458548)
- Return to the Hexga and give them the rocks
- Retrieve your reward from where the Hexga was sitting 

**Rewards:**
- [Auto Shell](#loc=454681) (Pictos)
- Colour of Lumina x3 (Must kill Hexga)
- Polished Chroma Catalyst (Must kill Hexga)
- Recoat (Must kill Hexga)

locations.title: Benisseur (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Head south, once inside the [Red Woods](#loc=448579), and speak with the talking fountain  

**Quest Steps:**
- You'll need to pay the talking fountain four times in the increments listed below:
  - Payment 1 - 5,000 Chroma
  - Payment 2 - 10,000 Chroma
  - Payment 3 - 25,000 Chroma
  - Payment 4 - 50,000 Chroma
- After all four payments (a total of 90,000 Chroma), the Benisseur will pop up and present your reward 

**Rewards:**
- [Recovery](#loc=452891) (Pictos)
- Grandiose Chroma Catalyst (Must kill Benisseur)

locations.title: Troubadour (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Head south, once inside the [Stone Quarry](#loc=448478), and speak with the Troubadour   

**Quest Steps:**
- Survive three rounds of Troubadour's playing without getting hit by a red orb, even once. 
- Allow the green orbs to hit you for a small bit of healing 
- In each subsequent round, the Troubadour's playing will get slightly quicker, so it's essential to focus on the end of the Nevron's trumpet to quickly identify whether you need to parry/dodge or let the orb hit you
- Speak with Troubadour again after completing all 3 rounds for your reward 

**Rewards:**
- [Healing Parry](#loc=448556) (Pictos)
- Resplendent Chroma Catalyst (Must kill Troubadour)

locations.title: Portier (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with the floating blue orb, found within the [Esoteric Ruins](#loc=448459) and agree to help the spirit retrieve the item from within the Esoteric Ruins Maze.  

**Quest Steps:**
1. Climb up the handholds on the northwestern wall, then use the rope to reach the top of the cliff. Walk down the hillside and head northwest to find the Esoteric Ruins Maze entrance
2. Shoot the glowing orb above the brazier near the entrance. This should open paths leading both left and right.
3. Next, walk into the room on your left.
4. Turn around to shoot the first glowing brazier again. At this point, both doorways should be blocked.
5. Shoot the glowing brazier in your current room to open the path west.
6. Walk west into the next room, take a right, and head to the other side of the maze to the far right room.
7. Once in the far right room, turn around and shoot the central brazier.
8. Finally, walk through the open doorway, take a left, then turn right to exit the maze, completing the Esoteric Ruins Maze puzzle!
9. Explore the area beyond the maze to collect several purple-colored items, including [Wood Boards](#loc=449744) found on the slanted rooftop at the center of the area
10. Return to the spirit and give them the [Wood Boards](#loc=449744) for your reward

**Note:**  There are several ways to complete the Esoteric Ruins Maze - when you shoot a brazier, pay attention to the glowing contrails that indicate which areas are being opened or blocked by your shots.

**Rewards:**
- [Protecting Heal](#loc=456534) (Pictos)
- Colour of Lumina x3 (Must kill Portier)
- Polished Chroma Catalyst (Must kill Portier)

locations.title: Danseuse Teacher (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** After entering [Frozen Hearts](#loc=448496), walk north of the Icebound Train Station Rest Point, and through the northwestern path left of the train. Next, go left to enter a cave and climb the rope.  On the upper level, turn left to travel southeast, then walk up the short staircase. Finally, follow the train tracks north, then drop down and speak with the Danseuse Teacher.

**Quest Steps:**
- Progress dialogue with the Teacher until you can select "Okay... I'm ready" to begin the challenge
- You must parry ALL incoming projectiles to perform a counterattack
- Speak with the Danseuse Teacher again after accomplishing this for your reward 

**Rewards:**
- [Danseuse (Lune)](#loc=504519)
- [Augmented Counter III](#loc=456360) (Pictos) (Must kill Danseuse Teacher)
- Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x3 (Must kill Danseuse Teacher)
- Recoat (Must kill Danseuse Teacher)

locations.title: Chalier (Nevron)
locations.description:
**How to Begin:** After accessing the [Floating Cemetery](#loc=448522), head northwest from the Entrance Rest Point to speak with the Chalier standing in front of a massive pile of corpses  

**Quest Steps:**
- The Nevron asks you to choose a weapon for them to fight you with 
- Defeat the Chalier in battle and collect your reward

**Rewards:**
- [Longer Shell](#loc=455110) (Pictos)
- [Auto Powerful](#loc=450907) (Pictos) (Must kill Chalier)

locations.title: Blanche
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** For the best possible rewards - make sure to complete all Friendly Nevron quests and be sure NOT to kill any of them before speaking with Blanche:
- [Jar (Nevron)](#loc=457667)
- [Demineur (Nevron)](#loc=457670)
- [Bourgeon (Nevron)](#loc=457673)
- [Hexga (Nevron)](#loc=457676)
- [Benisseur (Nevron)](#loc=457677)
- [Troubadour (Nevron)](#loc=457678)
- [Portier (Nevron)](#loc=457679)
- [Danseuse Teacher (Nevron)](#loc=457680)
- [Chalier (Nevron)](#loc=457681)

**How to Begin:** Speak with Blanche, found within [The Fountain](#loc=448596)    

**Quest Steps:**
- Successfully completing all prerequisites will grant you the reward below, else
- If the prerequisites are incomplete, [Blanche will become hostile and attack](#loc=454584) 

**Rewards:**
- Colour of Lumina x100

locations.title: Grandis Fashionist
locations.description:
**Location:** Found within [Monoco's Station](#loc=448427) wearing a red beret.  Answer his questions correctly with each of the three women and he'll reward the Pure Outfit to each:
- Lune: 
  - Life blooms like a rose, with petals soft and frail... -> Winter winds will whisper, the ending of the tale.
  - Life's a canvas painted with the colours of our strife... -> Death the artist's final stroke, completing every life.
  - Life sings a song of joy and pain, its notes both sweet and bitter... -> Its echoes fade to stillness, our secrets follow after.
- Maelle:
  - Life is but a fleeting dream, a whisper in the night... -> While shadows fade to silence, gone beyond our sight.
  - Through the veil of shadows, life's mysteries are spun... -> Death untangles threads, revealing what's begun.  
  - Life dances on the edge of time, a flicker in the breeze... -> Eternity then cradles us, a promise to appease.
- Sciel:
  - Life's a river winding through the valleys of despair... -> It meets the sea's embrace, where sorrow turns to air.
  - Life's a story written with the ink of dreams and fears... -> And death the final chapter, where we shed our tears.
  - Life's a blazing comet, racing through the sky... -> Its light will softly fade, where weary skies lie.

locations.title: Dear Expeditioners and Map Genies
locations.description:
I'd like to thank you for your patience with us in the making of this map. We are very happy to share all these interior maps with you. What you see is your game cartographer's decade long aspiration to do something unique and new.

We are still very much a small and dedicated team handling each and every game on Map Genie, so it can take a little more attention when we decide to dedicate ourselves to something new and deserving of the game. It's been a surprise and joy for this work to come to life with Clair Obscur Expedition 33. 

We hope the time it took us allowed the community to enjoy the game in-line with how we think developers would  like players to experience the story. So, thank you Expeditioner and thank you Sandfall Interactive. We can't wait for the next Clair Obscur!

Your Game Cartographer,

Loren Gilliland
